title: pr-324790-add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v74
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Add adaptive-batching reporting pipeline and representative workload runners used by the benchmark lab. This PR wires metric collection, profiling baselines, and reporting steps into the existing benchmark-lab CI so we can track adaptive batching impact across model families and sequence-length distributions. Motivation: the new adaptive batching runtime requires a stable reporting path to validate throughput/cost tradeoffs and detect quality regressions when batching strategies change. Without automated collection we cannot compare profiles or gate regressions on canary runs.

What this PR does:
- Adds a new pipeline job `benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching-report` that kicks off representative runners and profiling baselines, aggregates results, and uploads artifacts to S3/reporting service.
- Introduces `benchlab/runners/representative/adaptive_batching_runner.py` and updated `benchlab/profiling/baselines/*` to capture cold-start, steady-state, and tail latency distributions.
- Adds tags and metadata to reports to correlate model version, quantization profile, and infra tier.
- Adds a lightweight dashboard manifest to the reporting service for adaptive-batching comparisons.

Checklist:
- [x] Add CI job and scheduler trigger
- [x] Implement representative workload runners
- [x] Emit profiling baselines and upload artifacts
- [x] Add dashboards manifest
- [x] Add unit/integration tests for runners
- [x] Update docs with runbook and interpretation guide

Notes and compatibility:
- The new pipeline is opt-in and namespaced under `benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching` to avoid noise in existing reports.
- No breaking changes to existing benchmark-lab artifacts.
- See Linear ENG-2467 for acceptance criteria and gating rules.

How to run locally: `./benchlab/run_adaptive_report.sh --model redwood/small --seed 42 --upload false`

Related PRs: pr-289999, pr-296123 (adaptive batching infra), pr-320556 (profiling baselines v73).
